feature: Audit des talents des 493 espèces prises en charge et correctifs du moteur commun
method: Review of attribution, normal/hidden selection, legal evolution, corruption pools, entry/exit hooks, damage, accuracy, statuses, weather, reactions, held items and persistence.

One complete real-engine lifecycle plus checkpoint/permanent-identity check for every one of the 151 single-battle abilities. This is a smoke check, supplemented by targeted effect assertions; it is not exhaustive combination proof.
Controlled regression fixtures executed against committed pre-patch runtime compiled in memory, with no live-source rollback.
Actual SQL battle orchestrators and existing battle/network suites on explorakit_test; disposable accounts removed.

fixes.before: Type changed before the user could act, and read-only UI metadata or future impacts could mutate the type.
fixes.after: Only an executable, eligible move changes type. Gen7 repeated activation and STAB preserved; caller/future exclusions and menu read-only path covered.

fixes.before: Ground status moves such as Sand Attack were incorrectly blocked.
fixes.after: Ground damage stays blocked; status accuracy drops work. Mold Breaker and grounding rules kept.

fixes.before: Toxic became regular poison when reflected; reflection retained the original move type.
fixes.after: Gen7 toxic status retained. Ground move-type immunity does not block reflected paralysis; Safeguard, terrain and status-protection abilities still apply.

fixes.before: Shield Dust did not prevent contact poison.
fixes.after: Contact poison respects active Shield Dust; suppression allows it.

fixes.before: Thief/Covet could not bypass Sticky Hold with Mold Breaker.
fixes.after: Bypass is consistent with Knock Off. Ordinary theft still blocked; player-owned items restored after combat.

fixes.before: The toxic counter stopped while damage was blocked or replaced by healing.
fixes.after: Counter advances and caps at 15; damage resumes at the correct stage after ability suppression, with Gen7 flooring.
No HP loss with Magic Guard, but the Fire move still fails.

fixes.before: Bonus missed opposing voluntary switches because the new defender had no action timestamp.
fixes.after: The authoritative current action queue distinguishes remaining moves from switches/items/spent actions; timestamp fallback remains for standalone engine calls.

fixes.before: Zero/variable power metadata was ranked below weak attacks, and status-only sets gave a false warning.
fixes.after: OHKO, counter and dynamic power receive their threat ranks; status-only sets stay silent.

limitations: Five doubles-only abilities have no application in the current singles game; no doubles implementation added.
Honey Gather and Illuminate remain unavailable as overworld effects, matching the existing classification; not represented as implemented.

The full global suite is not green: 28 pre-existing failures (27 top-level failures plus one nested assertion) reproduced unchanged on the original committed engine; no unrelated story/map/shop/locked-mode edits.
No exhaustive guarantee over all possible move/item/weather/module combinations; no new browser or physical-device run.
Multitype keeps its item-dependent implementation; adding classic held plates and visual variants is outside this functional battle patch.
